scripts.dev:web: node init && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.dev:api: node init && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.build:web: node init && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:api: node init && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.build:shared-types: node init && npm run build -w packages/shared-types
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/api
